skills.observableOutcome: Counts groups of up to five objects using one-to-one correspondence.
Recognizes common two-dimensional shapes by their visible attributes.
Recognizes that plants need water and sunlight to grow.
Identifies the initial sound in familiar English and Arabic words.

activities.prompt: Ali has 3 mangoes. How many mangoes does he have?
activities.feedbackIncorrect: Count each mango once, then try again.

activities.prompt: مع علي ٣ حبات مانجو. كم حبة مانجو معه؟
activities.feedbackIncorrect: عدّ كل حبة مرة واحدة ثم حاول مرة أخرى.

activities.feedbackCorrect: Correct! A triangle has three sides.
activities.feedbackIncorrect: Look at the number of sides on each shape.
انظر إلى عدد أضلاع كل شكل ثم حاول مرة أخرى.

activities.prompt: Which pair helps a plant grow?
activities.feedbackCorrect: Great! Plants need water and sunlight.
activities.feedbackIncorrect: Think about what a plant needs to stay alive.

activities.prompt: أي زوج يساعد النبات على النمو؟
activities.feedbackCorrect: ممتاز! يحتاج النبات إلى الماء وضوء الشمس.
activities.feedbackIncorrect: فكّر فيما يحتاجه النبات ليعيش وينمو.

activities.prompt: Which word begins with the /s/ sound?
activities.feedbackCorrect: Yes! Sun begins with the /s/ sound.
activities.feedbackIncorrect: Say each word slowly and listen to its first sound.

activities.prompt: أي كلمة تبدأ بصوت حرف س؟
activities.feedbackCorrect: صحيح! كلمة سمكة تبدأ بحرف س.
activities.feedbackIncorrect: انطق الكلمات ببطء واستمع إلى الصوت الأول.
